name: fantasy-character-visual-dna
title_zh: 给角色抽一套不撞脸的视觉DNA，连咒语一起配好
tagline_zh: 从一张底图反推出可复用的角色基因，再生成风格一致的变体。不用反复喂参考图，改表情、换姿势。
tagline_en: Reverse-engineer a character's visual DNA from one base image, then spin off consistent variants. No more.
desc_en: Design distinctive fantasy characters and construct character base images through available image tools, paired with matching Midjourney prompts for further visual development. why_zh: 它把角色拆成可编辑的视觉参数，而不是简单垫图。产物自带MJ提示词。
why_en: It decomposes a character into editable visual parameters rather than just image-pasting. Outputs ship with MJ prompts, so later.
limit_zh: 只处理已有角色图的反推与变体，不负责从零设计新角色。画廊示例由MJ+Image2生成，本Skill不保证复现同等画质。
limit_en: Only reverse-engineers and varies existing character images; won't design from scratch. Gallery was made with MJ+Image2, not this Skill. Prompt-only.
title_en: Extract a character's visual DNA, with MJ prompts ready
